title: NTT to build $6.3bn data center for Anthropic in Japan - report
source_used: W.Media (relaying Nikkei Asia); opening paragraph of the Nikkei Asia article
key_facts: NTT Data Group is in the final stages of talks to build a data center in western Japan for US AI company Anthropic, multiple sources told Nikkei.
The facility, in Osaka, could cost about 1 trillion yen (US$6.3 billion) to build, with extra spending needed for servers and GPUs; partial operations could begin by 2028.
The site is expected to have 500 MW of power capacity, which would put it among Japan's largest data centers.
The companies reportedly aim to conclude negotiations by the end of NTT's fiscal 2026 (March 2027).
Neither NTT Data nor Anthropic has made an official statement or commented on the reported talks.
Getting 500 MW from the existing grid is a major challenge, so on-site generation and fuel cells are being considered at first.
NTT Data operates facilities with a combined capacity above 1,600 MW across Japan and other regions.
